limits: Full public start API and internal helper; selected original64ec/8d98, independent C and pinned publicv1.4.5 bodies plus authentic mask macro.
Stored original callback pointers are compared as ABI metadata; no function-entry stubs, callback bodies are not invoked by these functions.
Coherent synthetic USART1 context/RAM; PRIMASK at atomic writes and restoration compared. No UART FIFO or asynchronous lifetime model.
Internal unchecked cases use direct synthetic calls and do not establish application reachability.
No whole-HAL revision/compiler, hardware safety, allocation extent or firmware byte-equality claim.
